digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM model-class configuration and resolution
propositions: Model tier selection is inferred from an equality test against the framework default model, so the Pass-2/Pass-4 and completion verifier downgrades silently stop applying for any non-default (e.g. Bedrock) model id.
A single scalar knob (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express a per-tier model mapping across four passes, and a second scalar does not help.

Introduce three capability classes (trivial/standard/frontier) as config slots the operator fills with model/provider/endpoint plus optional fallback chain, referenced by class name everywhere internally.

Class names are reserved values in the existing model/model_ladder string space rather than a new schema key, resolved via a single resolve_model_string function called at three call sites (resolve_model, ladder expansion, verifier path).

REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE layers over discovered config with deep table merge (leaf key wins) and wholesale array replacement (fallback=[] disables fallbacks), without changing the shared shallow-merge read_reserved_section helper.

A two-provider gate run confirmed the per-pass class split survives crossing a provider boundary: 41 Pass-1 calls to anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 and 1 verifier call to bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6.
